messages:
Priya: Quick ping — I opened PR #2567 with a tiny cleanup: whitespace, one exported type rename, and a gofumpt run. It's blocking the prod branch merge (small dependency). Diff: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pull/2567

Alex: On my list. Can take a look this afternoon (~30m).

Diego: skimmed it earlier. mostly fine. One nit: rename `CacheOpts` -> `CacheOptions` is fine, but can we prefer the full word for exported types to avoid future churn? Also run `gofumpt` on the file (there's a couple of formatting diffs).

Priya: good call — I can update both. This is internal only, no changelog needed right?

Sam: no changelog needed for purely stylistic/name consistency. If it's just formatting + rename, squash and merge during the afternoon window. @merge-bot please hold merges for this branch until 16:00 UTC.

Priya: pushed a follow-up: renamed type, added a one-line doc comment, and ran `gofumpt`. Branch: `pr-2567-style-fix` (force-pushed).

Alex: quick read LGTM. small question: did you update any callers or was it just the file?

Priya: callers updated in the same commit (search/replace). CI passed locally, waiting on CI cloud run.

Diego: :thumbsup: looks good now. tiny suggestion: leave the doc comment explaining why the name changed (avoid future confusion). not a blocker.

Priya: added the comment. I'll squash into a single commit before merge. command I'll use: `git rebase -i origin/main` then `git push --force`.

merge-bot: Merge blocked — this repo requires 2 approvals before merging (automated check).

Sam: I can give the second approval at ~15:50 UTC, planning to merge during the 16:00 UTC window once approvals present. ping me when ready.

Alex: Approved. :rocket:

Diego: Approved. go ahead to merge after you squash.

Priya: Squashed and force-pushed, then merged at 16:03 UTC. Thanks everyone for the quick reviews — closing thread.

Sam: thanks! minimal blast radius and tidy history — appreciated.
